assumptions: One MAC job produces three outputs except current depthwise scheduling, which uses one selected lane and wastes two physical result lanes.
The illustrative estimate applies 2 cycles per accepted MAC group plus 12 cycles per single-context job turnover.
The illustrative estimate is neither a measurement nor a proven lower bound; replace its coefficients with actual runner endpoint measurements.
The final cadence fit uses the measured no-stall G=2 jobs: 2 ST_STORAGE + 2 ST_MAC_SEND + 10 ST_MAC_WAIT = 14 cycles/job, hence 2*G+10.
Only the down2 depthwise and pointwise G=2 runner were measured. G>2 layers use a conditional linear extrapolation, not a measured result or hard lower bound.
Conditional per-layer boundaries reuse measured down2 values: 27 cycles for depthwise and 28 for pointwise/stem. Bypass heads can differ and remain unmeasured.
SiLU-active is identified by graph int8 output; the six int16_q7_8 head outputs bypass activation.
DDR, non-convolution operators, decode, NMS, preload, export, and physical timing are excluded.

measured_runner_fit.scope: down2 4x4 tile, 256 DW jobs plus 128 PW jobs, all G=2
measured_runner_fit.mutually_exclusive_identity: 5376 MAC-state cycles + 54 drain-state cycles + 1 start edge = 5431

optimization_examples.name: wrapper product-shift-tag elastic register
optimization_examples.single_variable: insert one elastic register at the wrapper product/shift/tag boundary without changing arithmetic values or frozen arithmetic ports
optimization_examples.recommendation: recommended next isolated experiment for physical closure
optimization_examples.constraint: Adds one latency cycle; the maximum obligation bound must be re-measured and proved (it may rise from 30 to 31), together with tags, backpressure and all reset ages. It is not implemented or proved here and is not a frame-cycle optimization.

optimization_examples.name: runner consecutive group issue
optimization_examples.single_variable: overlap/prefetch ST_STORAGE so groups after the first issue on consecutive cycles
optimization_examples.constraint: Changes runner scheduling/interface timing and requires separate approval and full re-verification.

optimization_examples.name: single-context terminal turnover
optimization_examples.single_variable: remove one ST_MAC_WAIT-equivalent cycle per job
optimization_examples.constraint: The frozen MAC is already input-II=1; this changes terminal/next-job behavior.

optimization_examples.name: three-channel depthwise packing
optimization_examples.single_variable: use all three result lanes for adjacent DW channels
optimization_examples.constraint: Would require the shared 8-input path to cover 27 channel-specific activation terms across multiple groups, plus diagonal-weight, scheduling and storage adaptation; it is not free three-lane parallelism.
